craft_notes: Sthāyin: praise of the wit-abode. Device: dash→comma (home stated softly, thread released). Rejected: 'witty lords' modernising dhīpati — kept wit-lords (house diction); 'serpent-string' for yajñopavīta sense — killed: thread is exact, string cheapens. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Hail the home where wit-lords garland, the Master, the Pillar,
l4.sanskrit_cite: namo niḥśeṣadhīpatrimālālayamayātmane nāthāya sthāṇave tubhyaṃ nāgayajñopavītine

c1_essence: Remembrance alone cures ignorance-darkness; homage itself belongs to Īśa the fulfiller.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with prasāda (grace received and returned)
